name: Disarming Mixture
summary: At Stonewrought Dam, Chief Engineer Hinderweir prepares Disarming Mixture to stop a Seaforium charge planted by Dark Iron saboteurs.

sections.title: A Chemical Neutralizer
sections.body: The heavy Seaforium charge lies beneath the dam’s foundation, and no Mountaineers are close enough to help. Hinderweir turns to ingredients named by explosives expert Ashlan Stonesmirk. He stirs them into a chemical neutralizer, then mixes it with the powder keg underwater. The reactive compounds are neutralized, and the charge is left harmless.

faq.q: What is the Disarming Mixture used for?
faq.answer: The mixture neutralizes a large Seaforium explosive keg planted underwater at Stonewrought Dam’s foundation by Dark Iron insurgents.
Chief Engineer Hinderweir blends the ingredients while overseeing maintenance and defense at Stonewrought Dam.

faq.q: Why was the mixture necessary instead of simply disarming the bomb?
aliases: why use chemicals on the bomb
faq.answer: Dry Seaforium powder is harmless, but wet powder can explode with tremendous force. The mixture neutralizes the reactive powder while the keg remains submerged beneath the dam.

angles.text: For an engineer, the Disarming Mixture shows how chemical neutralization can render a volatile Seaforium charge harmless without setting it off.
As a dwarf, you help protect the valleys and lowlands around Stonewrought Dam. Applying the neutralizer quickly helps defend them.
